Talent0_2Ability.name: Corrupting Shadow
Talent0_2Ability.SpecificEffects: When both hands are intact and equipped with Chainsaw, releases <skill activeSkill=1019512>Corrupting Shadow</skill> after each action up to <color=#F74848>8</color> times per turn. When equipped with any backpack other than Weapon Switcher, <skill activeSkill=1019501>Hook - Grab</skill> and <skill activeSkill=1019511>Hook - Chase</skill> can be used. Gains <color=#F74848>1</color> stack <buf ID=1019509>Hook Charge</buf> at the start of combat, and <color=#F74848>1</color> stack <buf ID=1019509>Hook Charge</buf> at the end of turn.

Talent3_5Ability.name: Corrupting Shadow
Talent3_5Ability.SpecificEffects: When both hands are intact and equipped with Chainsaw, releases <skill activeSkill=1019512>Corrupting Shadow</skill> after each action up to <color=#F74848>8</color> times per turn. When equipped with any backpack other than Weapon Switcher, <skill activeSkill=1019501>Hook - Grab</skill> and <skill activeSkill=1019511>Hook - Chase</skill> can be used. Gains <color=#F74848>2</color> stacks <buf ID=1019509>Hook Charge</buf> at the start of combat, and <color=#F74848>1</color> stack <buf ID=1019509>Hook Charge</buf> at the end of turn. After using any [Hook] skill, the next active attack deals <color=#F74848>20%</color> more DMG.

100001.name: Mobile Warfare 1
100001.SpecificEffects: After breaking a part, <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf> can be triggered. Unable to move before the attack, and this can be effective up to <color=#F74848>2</color> times per turn.

101902.name: Two-Way Scheme
101902.SpecificEffects: When [Hook] skills are used on an ally unit, grants both [Maat] and the target Temporary HP equal to 10% of Maat's maximum HP, lasting for 2 turns. This effect cannot stack.

101903.name: Fearless Resolve
101903.SpecificEffects: For each 1 enemy carrying [Vengeful Edge], increases armor by 15%, up to 60%.

101904.name: Predation
101904.describe: Selects 1 empty tile within 3 adjacent tiles and jumps to the target. Gains 1 AP and 1 stack of [Hook Charge] upon arrival. Triggers [Re-ATK], allowing movement of 3 tiles before attacking. This skill can only be use when legs are intact.

101905.name: Crisis Control
101905.SpecificEffects: When any Arm is destroyed, restores <color=#F74848>50%</color> HP to <color=#F74848>1</color> Arm. This effect can trigger again after an interval of <color=#F74848>3</color> turns.

101906.name: Thorn Annihilation
101906.describe: Selects a main target. Uses a Chainsaw to attack all enemies within 1-ring area, dealing 0.9x AoE DMG, consuming all [Vengeful Edge] on targets hit. Then attacks the main target, dealing 0.9x DMG. Each 2 stacks of [Vengeful Edge] increases the hit count of the second attack by +1, up to +8. This attack always hits the body.

101907.name: Eternal Way
101907.SpecificEffects: After using any [Hook] skill, if [Hook Charge] is 1 or less, consumes 1 PP to restore 1 [Hook Charge]. This effect can trigger 1 time per turn. Gains 2 PP at the start of battle.

101908.name: Severance
101908.describe: Uses Chainsaw to attack a target, dealing 0.7x DMG. Enters [Aiming] Mode before attacking. This attack does not consume [Vengeful Edge]. Triggers [Re-ATK] after combat, allowing movement of 2 tiles before attacking. This skill can only be used 1 time per turn.

100011.name: Mobile Warfare 2
100011.SpecificEffects: Upon triggering <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf>, allows movement of <color=#F74848>2</color> tiles before attacking.

100021.name: Mobile Warfare 3
100021.SpecificEffects: Destroying the target can trigger <buf ID=900005>[Re-Act]</buf>, allowing action with full movement distance.

100022.name: Power Innovation 2
100022.SpecificEffects: When breaking a part, restore <color=#F74848>1</color> AP after combat, effective up to <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn.

100031.name: Alacrity 1
100031.SpecificEffects: During an Active Attack with a Melee Weapon, there is a <color=#F74848>20%</color> chance to trigger <buf ID=900001>[Flurry Strike]</buf> following the enemy’s attack, dealing <color=#F74848>0.5x</color> DMG.

100033.name: Mobile Warfare 4
100033.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf> or <buf ID=900005>[Re-Act]</buf>'s effective times per turn <color=#F74848>+1</color>.

100034.name: Alacrity 2
100034.SpecificEffects: Before an Active Attack, the probability of triggering <buf ID=900001>[Flurry Strike]</buf> increases by <color=#F74848>6%</color> for each <color=#F74848>1</color> tile moved, up to <color=#F74848>30%</color>.

100035.name: Alacrity 3
100035.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=900001>[Flurry Strike]</buf> damage multiplier is increased to <color=#F74848>0.75</color>.

100036.name: Alacrity 4
100036.SpecificEffects: When triggering <buf ID=900001>[Flurry Strike]</buf>, prioritize hitting the part with the lowest HP.

101941.name: Burning Karma 1
101941.SpecificEffects: When a target is destroyed, gains 1 stack of [Hook Charge]. This effect can trigger 1 time per turn.

100043.name: Power Innovation 3
100043.SpecificEffects: When destroying a target, additionally restore <color=#F74848>1</color> AP after combat, effective up to <color=#F74848>2</color> times per turn.

101944.name: Burning Karma 2
101944.SpecificEffects: If 1 or more stacks of [Vengeful Edge] are consumed this turn, gains 1 AP at the end of turn.

101945.name: Burning Karma 3
101945.SpecificEffects: For each 1 enemy within 1-ring, DMG dealt increases by 4% and DMG taken reduces by 4%, up to 20%.

hiddenSkills.name: Splitter
hiddenSkills.describe: Uses a Chainsaw to attack a target, dealing 1.1x DMG. Consumes all [Vengeful Edge] on target hit. This attack always hit the part with lowest HP.
